# Domain Rules Checklist: Shopping Lists

**Purpose**: Check that the business rules for lists, the current list, items, ticking, finishing shopping, removal and undo, quantities, names, search and categories are complete, clear, consistent and free of conflicts before implementation starts
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), with [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/driving-ports.md](../contracts/driving-ports.md) and [contracts/ui-validation.md](../contracts/ui-validation.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Audience and depth**: reviewer, standard depth, used as a gate before `/speckit-implement`. Persistence, storage failures and data invariants are covered by [data.md](data.md); screen states, messages and accessibility by [ux.md](ux.md). They are not repeated here.

## Lists and the Current List

- [x] CHK001 - Does the spec state whether a newly created list becomes current, or only appears among the lists? The contract says `createList` does not make it current, while FR-024 and US3-2 are silent. [Gap, Spec §FR-024, Spec §US3-2, Contract §createList]
- [x] CHK002 - Is choosing the list that is already current defined (a no-op, or a change that ends the "Annuler" offer as "switching the current list" does in FR-010)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK003 - Is "its number of items" on the screen of my lists defined as all items or only those left to put in the cart, and is it consistent with FR-006's remaining count on the current list? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3-8, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the rule "items are changed only on the current list" (FR-008) stated for every item action, including finishing shopping and undo, and consistent with US2-5's wording? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-010]

## Ticking and Finishing Shopping

- [x] CHK005 - Is it specified what happens when "Terminer les courses" is confirmed while tick saves on that list are still waiting (FR-004's queue): are the waiting taps saved before, after, or dropped? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 - Is it specified what happens when an item is removed while a tick on it is still waiting to be saved: which ticked state the undo snapshot keeps, and what happens to the waiting tap? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 - Does "any other change" ending the "Annuler" offer explicitly include a tick or untick, and is that intended in the store, where a user may tick the next item before noticing a wrong removal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 - Is it stated whether a refused input (a blank name, an invalid quantity) or a failed save counts as a "change" that ends the "Annuler" offer? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the visibility rule of "Terminer les courses" (FR-007) stated in terms of saved state or shown state, given that a tick is shown before its save finishes and may revert? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the ticked state of an item after a quantity change (FR-015) stated in the spec, and not only in the data model's state transitions ("same inCart")? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §State transitions]

## Adding, Removing and Undo

- [x] CHK011 - Is the "offer to change its quantity" of an article already on the list (FR-011, US2-8) defined as the same flow and validation as FR-015, including clearing the quantity and keeping the ticked state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK012 - Does US2-9 define what "the existing 'Beurre' is offered instead" means: added to the list with the quantity typed in the create form, or offered for the user to choose? [Clarity, Spec §US2-9]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the case covered where the duplicate offered by US2-9 is already on the current list, so FR-011 and FR-021 apply together? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §US2-9, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK014 - Is it specified whether article creation is offered when a search shows matches but none has the typed name (searching "pâté" shows "Pâte", since search ignores accents, yet "Pâté" is a different name under FR-021)? US2-14 only offers creation when nothing matches. [Gap, Spec §US2-14, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the name prefilled from the search query (US2-14) specified as the raw typed text or the cleaned query? [Clarity, Spec §US2-14, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK016 - Is it stated that an article added again after its removal became final starts unticked and without its earlier quantity (FR-012), so it is not confused with an undo? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK017 - Is it specified which category, if any, is preselected when creating an article from a browsed category, from a search with no match, or from the "no article in this category" empty state? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, Spec §US2-14, Spec §US2-15]

## Quantities

- [x] CHK018 - Is the message for "-2" defined? FR-016 lists signs among the format errors "stating the rule", US2-12 expects the "must be a positive number" message for a negative number, and the data model maps a leading "-" to `AmountNotPositive`. [Conflict, Spec §FR-016, Spec §US2-12, Data Model §Quantity]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the precedence between quantity errors defined when an input breaks several rules ("0,0000" is both zero and too precise; "-99999" is signed and too large), or does it live only in the data model's table order? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Quantity]
- [x] CHK020 - Is it stated whether a unit keeps the case and spelling typed ("KG", "Kg", "kg") and whether two items may show the same amount with differently written units, consistent with "no unit conversion"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK021 - Do the quantity rules of FR-016 and FR-022 explicitly apply to both entry points, adding an article (FR-014) and changing a quantity (FR-015, FR-011)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK022 - Is it specified how an amount is shown when it has 3 decimals and a unit ("0,125 kg"), and whether the shown value always matches the value saved, so no rounding happens between entry, storage and display? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Data Model §SQLite schema]

## Names, Uniqueness and Search

- [x] CHK023 - Is it intended that names equal for search but different under FR-021 may coexist ("Oeufs" and "Œufs", "Mais" and "Maïs")? Uniqueness keeps accents and "œ", search ignores both. [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK024 - Are the apostrophe and hyphen variants common in French names (straight ' and typographic ’, "Pâte d'amande", "Pommes-de-terre") covered by the search and uniqueness rules, or explicitly treated as different characters? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK025 - Is "space" in the cleaning rules defined to include tabs, line breaks and the non-breaking spaces French typing inserts, and is a name made only of invisible characters (zero-width space) defined as blank? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022, Data Model §Name]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the sort order defined for names that start with digits or contain numbers ("Lait 2 L" and "Lait 10 L"), or is plain French collation explicitly accepted? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the name uniqueness rule stated as "within its kind" for all three kinds, so an article, a category and a list may share a name ("Barbecue")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-024]

## Categories

- [x] CHK028 - Is it intended that user-created categories come after "Divers", whose name suggests it is the last catch-all category, and is this order stated as fixed until reordering ships? [Clarity, Spec §Entities, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 - Is it specified whether a user may create a category named like a default one written differently ("fruits et légumes"), and is US4-3's duplicate message the stated outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, Spec §US4-3]
- [x] CHK030 - Are the default category names stated as data set up once (kept as stored, not translated or renamed on update), consistent with FR-040's rule that updates keep all data? [Assumption, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-040]

## Domain Failures and Limits

- [x] CHK031 - Are the data sizes in the Assumptions (1 000 articles, 20 lists, 200 items per list) stated as performance targets only, or as limits the application enforces when the user creates more? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK032 - Are the business-rule failures that no valid input can cause (a missing list, article, category or item; finishing shopping with nothing in the cart) listed with the situation that raises each, so FR-030's "any other returned failure" can be traced to them? [Traceability, Spec §FR-030, Contract §Conventions, Data Model §State transitions]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the race covered where a tap reaches an item that a just-made change has removed (a removal, or an undo whose save failed), and is the resulting failure classed as expected or unexpected under FR-030? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-030]

## Terminology and Cross-Feature Consistency

- [x] CHK034 - Are "article", "item", "list item", "ticked" and "in the cart" used consistently across FRs, scenarios and the entity definitions, with "item" never meaning a catalog article? [Consistency, Spec §Entities]
- [x] CHK035 - Are the name and quantity rules that 002-manage-articles relies on (uniqueness, cleaning, length, renaming to an existing name) cited from FR-021 and FR-022 rather than restated, so the two specs cannot drift? [Dependency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-022]
